shared_elements: animal in profile with four legs
row of repeated short vertical strokes
horizontal register or banded division of the surface
curved/arc motifs repeated in a row
justification: Both surfaces stack their imagery into roughly horizontal registers and both include a repeated row of short vertical strokes (crew-marks above the boat in A, the hatched band in B) plus profile quadrupeds and long-necked birds, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is flat red pigment drawn in open linear outline over an irregular natural rock face dominated by boats, while B is three-dimensional low relief carved on a shaped free-standing pillar with modelled animal bodies and no watercraft.
